channel.description: An aggregated feed of Technology-related news

item.title: AI automation startup Relay shuts down, staff joins Google’s Chrome team
item.description: Relay, which offered businesses workflow automation, will stop operating next month. Its CEO and some of its staff plan to get to work on Google Chrome next.

item.title: World's largest 3D printing facility builds drone boats using robotic arms
item.description: Florida manufacturer Haddy has used robotic 3D printing to produce a military drone boat, building on earlier rapid unmanned vessel projects.

item.title: I’m a diehard Firefox user — and its new ad blocker rolling out on iOS could finally let me switch from Safari
item.description: Firefox’s iOS app now has a built-in ad blocker to protect your browsing privacy.

item.title: ABC’s livestreamed news show is powered by trending topics
item.description: ABC News has officially introduced Searched, a livestreamed show that highlights stories people are discussing on social media and searching on the web, as reported earlier by Variety. Though the network just announced the show now, Searched began airing on the ABC News Live streaming channel in April, which appears on both Disney Plus and […]

item.title: Meta might be on the hook for $1.4 trillion if it loses a landmark lawsuit and that would truly mark the end of social media as we know it
item.description: Meta and Mark Zuckerberg are about to face their toughest trial yet. How the huge State AG's lawsuit could force Meta to make some difficult decisions.

item.title: Your YouTube video views are about to skyrocket. Heres why.
item.description: YouTube is changing how video view metrics are counted on the platform.

item.title: What are your retro game consoles worth?
item.description: Many variables affect the value of retro game consoles today. Which ones are worth keeping, and which ones are destined for the trash?

item.title: German defense giant tests moving truck launcher carrying 18 kamikaze drones
item.description: Rheinmetall tested a truck-mounted launcher carrying 18 FV-014 drones, demonstrating swarm capability, armour penetration, and long-range flight during live trials.

item.title: ‘Unprecedented’ number of Apple users received recent spyware alert, say investigators
item.description: Cybersecurity experts who investigate spyware attacks say the number of people who received a recent threat notification from Apple is unusually high.

item.title: This R-Rated Film Studio Wants to Be the HBO of AI
item.description: Rogue Studios, a new cinematic adult AI-generator, is betting big on the future of “sophisticated” spicy content.

item.title: YouTube public view counts will likely get higher starting next week
item.description: The platform will start tracking views the same way across video formats.

item.title: Power on... Marvel's new X-Men movie cast reveal at D23 Expo 2026 — and why it proves leak culture is broken
item.description: With the official cast reveal for its new X-Men movie, Marvel exposed the legitimacy of numerous self-proclaimed insiders.

item.title: Disneyland as you know it is changing in a big way
item.description: Disney is reshaping some of its most recognizable areas as new rides, expansions and a major Tomorrowland overhaul move forward. Tomorrow’s Tomorrowland at Disneyland could look very different than it does today.

item.title: Russian websites could soon be easy pickings for hackers as security certificates expire — banks, emails, and government systems all potentially at risk
item.description: Russia's websites lost their trusted certificates, and the fix Moscow is offering asks users to install a state root that can vouch for any site on the internet.

item.title: Save up to $300 on your TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 pass until August 21
item.description: If you’ve been circling around Disrupt, then now’s the best time to lock in your pass and start getting ready to join the rest of the startup community gathering in San Francisco from October 13-15 at Moscone West!

item.title: Reddit is experimenting with video and audio versions of posts
item.description: The company wants users to be able to watch and listen to conversations.
